judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the photo at the top of the Abraham Lincoln Birthplace result card. It sits inside the card's link, next to the visible h3 'Abraham Lincoln Birthplace', 'National Historical Park' and 'Kentucky'. The crop matches the screenshot at the element's bounds and shows a white neoclassical memorial building among trees. The park's own homepage (checked live on 2026-10-23) uses this exact file as its banner, with og:image:alt 'Memorial building with stairs leading up', so this is the Memorial Building at the birthplace site. The page script builds the alt as park name + ' banner image' when no alt is stored. That text correctly identifies the picture as this park's banner and claims nothing the image fails to show. The alt is generic and repeats the link text, which is a quality point (a null alt or a short description would be better), but it is not the mismatch the finding reports.
